title.narrative: FCDO Mine Action project appointed via NPA

description.narrative: Key outputs of the project are: up to two rounds of stakeholder consultation, a GMAP3-focused workshop, Fifth Review Conference side event, tailored reporting indicators, a set of suggested environmental indicators, promotion through the Environmental Issues and Mine Action working group, revised GFT with guidance, and final project report.

The overall objective of this project is to strengthen the environmental and climate awareness and reduce the environmental impact of mine action through assessing, managing and reporting on the reduction of environmental risks, to support safe and productive land use for affected communities. This project has four key objectives: Objective #1 To better understand the current gaps in the environmental assessments carried out across the global mine action sector, and to identify good practice and lessons learned from recent trials of the NPA GFT, as well as from other humanitarian organizations. Objective #2 Refine and improve the GFT, including the use of other digital platforms to improve accessibility, ease-of-use and shareability with others. Objective #3 Develop meaningful and relevant environmental reporting indicators. Objective #4 Share the GFT outputs across the global mine action sector, with training material and guidance in place.

This project will facilitate the wider use and further development of field assessment tools and reporting indicators, to improve environmental safeguarding across mine action and fill the gap related to consistent environmental monitoring and reporting in the mine action sector. Environmental safeguarding includes measures to prevent harm or enhance the environment.
